topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: The attic door creaks under my touch, a chill whispering through the small gap. I step inside, the air heavy with the scent of old wood and forgotten time. Boxes and trinkets lie scattered, each one a silent witness to lives once lived here. Each shadow seems to stretch a little longer, every tick of the unseen clock echoing louder. I tread softly, as if the quiet could protect me from whatever secrets might be contained in these forgotten relics. The light from the small window is thin, barely piercing the dense quiet. My fingers graze the edges of dusty books and faded photographs, each touch a fragile bridge to a past that seems to watch and wait, still and patient.
